title: should publish a critical banner and render it for a non-meta org
verifies: an operator-authored critical banner persists and renders above the toolbar for a non-meta org

title: should keep a dismissed banner hidden across reload
verifies: dismissing a banner hides it immediately and persists across a page reload via localStorage

title: should reject an empty message with a client-side validation error
verifies: the dialog refuses an empty message and stays open without adding a banner

title: should reject a non-http(s) CTA link with a client-side validation error
verifies: a javascript: CTA URL is rejected client-side and the banner is not added

title: should order banners by severity and suppress promo while critical is active
verifies: live banners render severity-descending and a promo banner is suppressed while a critical banner is active, then appears once critical is removed

title: should return 403 for non-meta org config access and 200 for the live read
verifies: the authoring config endpoint is forbidden for non-meta orgs while the live read stays open
